title: Deye three-phase hybrid Modbus register map (public translated mirror)
summary: A public English translation mirror of the Deye three-phase hybrid Modbus document defines holding-register telemetry at 500-683. The observed Kevolt proxy trace independently corroborates the implemented addresses and most scales. Where the translated rated-power unit conflicts with the reported hardware and captured raw value, the implementation follows the hardware-correlated trace and records the discrepancy. The mirror is treated as register-map evidence, not as proof of official hosting or model identity.
